about_the_game:
"would you date me for just three months?"

You are a second-year university student who confesses to Saebom at the university entrance, only to be publicly rejected. But then, in an unexpected turn of events, Saebom herself proposes a three-month contract dating arrangement. Accepting her proposal, you begin a risky three-month relationship.

Your sudden relationship news raises suspicion among those around you. A junior who secretly harbors feelings and her sister continue to bring crisis to your relationship.

Within this complicated dynamic, you must perfect the act of being the ideal lover.

Amid thrilling moments that keep arising, can you safely make it through three months of contract dating?

Act as the Perfect Lover and Protect Your Relationship

You enter into a three-month fake relationship with Saebom, who rejected your confession. As you work to achieve each of your own goals, the story unfolds with you deceiving those around you and overcoming crises while maintaining your lover act. Experience a romantic comedy where real feelings intertwine as you deceive others—and sometimes even yourself.

Unpredictable Chemistry in a Fake Relationship

Life transforms completely after becoming fake lovers.

You face thrilling moments amid suspicious gazes, and in your once-ordinary daily life, you find yourself constantly aware of the relationship. And the junior who keeps approaching you... urges you toward a different choice.

Enjoy the sweet chemistry created by this strange distance between you.

Gameplay

Your choices determine your relationships with 2 heroines, Four main endings await based on the path you take and the heroine you pursue.

Game Features

  • Full Voice Acting Throughout: Featuring professional voice actors including the main heroines and extras for an immersive experience.

  • Abundant Story Volume: Featuring the essence of romantic comedy in 10 hours of story crafted by a professional serialization author.

  • Diverse Visual Effects: Immerse yourself with varied CGs, SD illustrations, and screen effects tailored to each scene.

  • Original Soundtrack: A custom-composed soundtrack that creates a memorable experience tied to the narrative.

  • Multiple Endings Based on Your Choices: You directly choose how your contract dating relationship ends.

  • Stunning Visuals: 22 CGs and 13 mini-CGs maintain immersion throughout.

Special Scenes That Complete the Climax

Added special scenes that complete your relationships with both heroines.

Characters

Lee Saebom

The one who rejected your confession. For personal reasons, she proposes the contract dating arrangement to you.

Yu yeong

Your two-year junior at school. Clever and fox-like in nature, she has harbored feelings for you for a long time. Upon hearing of your romantic disappointment, she initially tried to approach you, but instead finds herself burning with jealousy when news of your new relationship breaks.

Lee Gaeul

Saebom's older sister. Hearing that her younger sibling has a boyfriend, she returns to Korea to verify. The boyfriend she actually meets seems to have no major faults. Though worried and hopeful, she simply wishes for her sister's relationship to flourish.

Kim Do-ah

Your best friend. Unable to refuse requests, he's always being dragged along by those around him. While he often gives romantic advice, he himself has no dating experience whatsoever.

content_descriptors.notes:
All characters in this game are adults.
The game includes scenes depicting intimate relationships with the heroines in their true endings, and all depictions comply with Korean content rating standards.

Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows® 7
  • Processor: Intel Core i / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 530
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: On a spring day beneath falling cherry blossoms, your confession is publicly rejected. But she then proposes something unexpected: three months of contract dating. What was meant to be fake becomes complicated when a devoted junior's hidden feelings emerge. Can this arranged love become real?
supported_languages:
English, Japanese, Korean*, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support
